title: a branch GitHub calls clean while it is behind main hears main moved by the spec's words
status: fixed in the spec after 0.4.1: its Work in the open says a pull request GitHub calls clean, unstable or has_hooks may merge as it stands under the repository's rules and hears nothing, which the library as built already keeps (DESIGN.md, 13)

steps.note: the repository's rules do not require an up-to-date branch, or there are none, and no rule holds the draft, so GitHub's word for it is clean whether or not its branch is behind, as GitHub gives a draft its branch's word (C0); the draft is level with main, and nothing is owed

the branch is now behind main and GitHub's word is still clean: the repository's rules let the draft merge as it stands, so the spec owes it nothing; under the mutant that compares such a word the board tells it main moved, made and not owed, and G10 is red
